items.title: 14.13 Analyse data and interpret air quality

blocks.text: The collected data are analysed to confirm or refute the hypothesis, and the results are interpreted and conclusions drawn. Analysing and interpreting air-quality data involves understanding the concentrations of the pollutants, identifying trends over time, and assessing the implications for public health and environmental policy. By carefully designing experiments and collecting and analysing data, a hypothesis about air quality can be tested and strategies for improving air quality can be made.
